consequence.statement: The tls.caOptional option in Redis provider static configuration will be ignored in v3.0.0, as the option has been removed.

original.statement: The Redis provider's tls.caOptional configuration option has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0.

consequence.statement: The removed providers.redis.tls.caOptional option is no longer honoured in v3. The migration guide says it should be removed from the Redis provider static configuration, because TLS client authentication is a server-side option.
consequence.remediation: Remove tls.caOptional (providers.redis.tls.caOptional / --providers.redis.tls.caOptional) from the Redis provider static configuration.

corrected.statement: Traefik v3.0.0 removed the Redis provider static option providers.redis.tls.caOptional, so a configured value is no longer honoured. The option has to be removed from the static configuration (file or CLI). Impact is low because TLS client authentication is a server-side setting.

decision.reason: [ev-9f184d231baf] says the Redis provider `tls.caOptional` option "has been removed in v3" and should be removed from the static configuration. A removed static key that is no longer honoured fits setting-ignored. The same text explains why it was removed: TLS client authentication is a server-side option, so the option never had a real effect on the Redis client connection. That makes "high" severity an over-claim; low fits better. The evidence does not say startup fails, so I kept the kind as setting-ignored.
